b2-brasilnordeste-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides of Salvador
b2-brasilnordeste-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Salvador, and he says the old port was mostly in the high part of the city.
b2-brasilnordeste-01.prompt: Correct Carlos: the Lower City is the port, and the Upper City is on the cliff, as a comparison.
cues: Say that the Lower City is the port
Compare it with the Upper City
b2-brasilnordeste-01.target: La Ciudad Baja es el puerto; la Ciudad Alta, en cambio, está sobre el acantilado.
b2-brasilnordeste-01.english: The Lower City is the port; the Upper City, on the other hand, is on the cliff.
b2-brasilnordeste-01.canDo: I can set one idea about Salvador against another with *en cambio*, *por el contrario*, *al contrario*, *no obstante* and *ahora bien*.

b2-brasilnordeste-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Drums Are For
b2-brasilnordeste-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are watching a documentary about Candomblé, and she asks why the drums are played in the ceremony.
b2-brasilnordeste-02.prompt: Tell Meg, as the tradition says, that the drums are played so that the orixá arrives.
cues: Say that the drums are played
b2-brasilnordeste-02.target: Según la tradición, se tocan los atabaques para que el orixá llegue al terreiro.
b2-brasilnordeste-02.english: According to the tradition, the drums are played so that the orixá arrives at the terreiro.
b2-brasilnordeste-02.canDo: I can say what something is for with *para que* + subjunctive, about Candomblé and capoeira.

b2-brasilnordeste-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Drought
b2-brasilnordeste-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading about the sertão, and he asks why so many families left it.
b2-brasilnordeste-03.prompt: Tell Carlos, as a guess about the past, that if it had rained more many families would not have left.
cues: Say what would not have happened
b2-brasilnordeste-03.target: Si hubiera llovido más, muchas familias no habrían salido del sertão.
b2-brasilnordeste-03.english: If it had rained more, many families would not have left the sertão.
b2-brasilnordeste-03.canDo: I can say what would have happened in a different past with *si hubiera* + participle and *habría* + participle, about the sertão.

b2-brasilnordeste-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Remembering Zumbi
b2-brasilnordeste-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading about Palmares, and she asks what happened after the first expeditions.
b2-brasilnordeste-04.prompt: Tell Meg that the army attacked the quilombo again in 1694.
cues: Use *volver a* to say it happened again, with the year
b2-brasilnordeste-04.target: El ejército volvió a atacar el quilombo en 1694.
b2-brasilnordeste-04.english: The army attacked the quilombo again in 1694.
b2-brasilnordeste-04.canDo: I can say that something happened again with *volver a* + infinitive, about Palmares and Zumbi.

b2-brasilnordeste-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Quota Law
b2-brasilnordeste-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are preparing a short talk, and he asks what the law of 2012 changed in universities.
b2-brasilnordeste-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that, as a result of the 2012 law, federal universities reserve places for public school students.
b2-brasilnordeste-05.target: A raíz de la ley de 2012, las universidades federales reservan plazas para estudiantes de escuelas públicas.
b2-brasilnordeste-05.english: As a result of the 2012 law, federal universities reserve places for public school students.
b2-brasilnordeste-05.canDo: I can explain a cause in a formal way with *debido a* and *a raíz de*, about race and equality in Brazil.

b2-brasilnordeste-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Northeast in Review
b2-brasilnordeste-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a talk, and she asks you to compare the two levels of Salvador.
b2-brasilnordeste-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what existed in the interior of the Northeast in the 17th century and what happened to its leader.
b2-brasilnordeste-consolidation.target: En el siglo XVII existió en el interior del Nordeste el Quilombo dos Palmares, y en 1695 murió su líder, Zumbi.
b2-brasilnordeste-consolidation.english: In the 17th century the Quilombo dos Palmares existed in the interior of the Northeast, and in 1695 its leader, Zumbi, died.
b2-brasilnordeste-consolidation.canDo: I can set one idea about Salvador against another with *en cambio*, *por el contrario*, *al contrario*, *no obstante* and *ahora bien*.
